look.why: A crisp glacial sky blue that echoes high Himalayan snowfields and sets off the smoky-grey spotted coat.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 2.1 m including the 0.9 m tail (body length 1–1.3 m per ADW)

habitat.text: Steep, rocky alpine mountains and cliffs across Central and South Asia at 3,000–5,500 m.

diet.text: Blue sheep, Siberian ibex, marmots, pikas and mountain birds ambushed on rocky ledges.

facts.text: Its thick tail is nearly as long as its body and works as a balance pole on cliffs and a scarf while sleeping.
Unlike lions and tigers, snow leopards cannot roar because their vocal cords lack a thick elastic pad.

id.diet: Domba biru, ibex Siberia, marmot, pika, dan burung gunung yang disergap dari tebing batu.
facts: Ekornya yang tebal hampir sepanjang tubuhnya dan berfungsi sebagai penyeimbang di tebing sekaligus syal saat tidur.
Tidak seperti singa dan harimau, macan tutul salju tidak bisa mengaum karena pita suaranya tidak memiliki bantalan elastis tebal.
